next_step: Finalize POC results, get pricing approval from finance, schedule Dedicated sizing call with infra team
notes:
Background: Brookfield Infermetrics builds a B2B analytics product that surfaces insights from customer documents and chat-based assistants for product teams. They're a mid-market SaaS (201-1k employees) currently using another LLM API provider for chat + embeddings. Evaluating Redwood Hosted as a migration path and then Dedicated (reserved capacity + VPC) for production.

Key quote (CTO): "We need parity — if answers degrade even slightly users will blame the model, not the infra. No regressions on intent-level accuracy."

POC summary / technical asks:
- Initial hosted POC executed (2 week run) to validate API compatibility and perf envelope.
- Primary goal: drop-in compat layer so backend code (templating, function-calls) needs minimal change. Team built shim to map existing API calls to Redwood.
- Evaluating prompt parity: format differences (function-calling semantics, trailing whitespace, JSON strictness) caused eval regressions on 3/30 test prompts. Need templating guidance and recommended tokenizer-safe prompt patterns.
- Regression concerns: Reranker scores shifted on edge cases (6% drop on labeled rerank set). Investigating model/temperature/settings parity vs provider baseline.
- Latency targets: 95th < 250ms for chat endpoint (target), currently baseline provider 95th ~120ms; Redwood hosted POC 95th ~180ms. Team happy with hosted <250ms but wants Dedicated for predictable tail.
- Throughput: average 90 req/s across tenants, spiky bursts to 350 req/s for nightly batch re-ranks. Need Dedicated sizing that supports burst autoscaling + KV cache reuse across requests.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high. Finance asks for delta analysis (hosted tokens vs current provider and projected Dedicated commit).
- Security: must pass SOC2 + SSO (SAML/Okta) + audit logs + KMS key wrap. Data residency: USA-only for certain clients.

Engagement timeline (high level):
- 2026-02-15: Intro call w/ AE + SE (see ff:2026-02-15-1123). Covered product architecture, initial constraints.
- 2026-02-20: Technical deep-dive w/ infra + platform eng. Redwood SE captured request for VPC peering window and Dedicated sizing.
- 2026-02-23: Hosted POC kickoff — provided test prompts, sample rerank set, and baseline metrics.
- 2026-03-01: Mid-POC review; SE recommended prompt templating changes and provided Optimize recommendations (batching, KV cache). (see ff:2026-03-01-6790)
- 2026-03-08: POC closeout meeting — initial parity gap analysis; agreed to run additional tuning + one-week follow-up.

Stated requirements / acceptance criteria:
- API compat layer that minimizes application changes (<= 2 dev-days to swap shim).
- No more than 3% drop in rerank precision/recall on labeled validation set or a documented mitigation plan.
- 95th latency under 250ms for chat under production-like load; predictable tail with Dedicated.
- SAML SSO + SOC2 attestation + per-token audit logs + optional KMS integration.

Risks noted by customer:
- Hidden regressions due to different sampling / model weights despite same model label.
- Prompt engineering cost: engineering time to re-template prompts for strict JSON outputs.
- Migration window for networking/VPC peering may delay Dedicated go-live.

Sales/Champion signals:
- Head of Product (champion) wants Redwood for better cost controls and observability.
- Infra lead prefers Dedicated for SLA and predictable perf.
- Finance is conservative; wants a 12-month TCO comparison before commit.

Open action items (owner in parens):
- Provide deep-dive parity report with token-level diffs and suggested prompt changes (Diego).
- Run third tuning pass on reranker (customer + Redwood SE joint).
- Draft Dedicated sizing + price band and show 3 commit tiers (Samantha).
- Security checklist: provide SOC2 report + KMS integration guide (Priya + Security Eng).
- Schedule Dedicated sizing call for week of 2026-03-22 (Samantha).
